newsitem.title: JAPAN: NKK to take stake in Brazil steel plant--paper.
newsitem.headline: NKK to take stake in Brazil steel plant--paper.

text.p: NKK Corp plans to buy a 10 percent stake in a joint venture that will build a steel plant in Brazil, a Japanese newspaper reported on Friday.

Business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said the venture is expected to start operations in two to three years and will produce about one million tonnes of crude steel annually. With the crude steel, the venture will make steel construction materials initially but is expected to make steel sheets for cars in the future, the paper said.
An NKK spokesmen was not available for comment.
